headlines.title: House votes on Hegseth impeachment resolution
headlines.description: Watch live coverage as the House of Representatives holds votes on Republican Rep. Thomas Massie's impeachment resolution against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

headlines.title: What are childhood vaccination rates in your community and schools?
headlines.description: This is part of The Vaccine Divide, an updated data investigation into America potentially losing its measles-free status as the deadly virus roars back and childhood vaccine defenses continue to crack and crumble.

headlines.title: Behind the data: How NBC News tracked the decline in childhood vaccinations
headlines.description: How an NBC News data investigation tracked vaccination and school exemption rates across thousands of counties in the U.S.

headlines.title: House Republicans elect Rep. Jim Jordan as next minority leader
headlines.description: Republicans in the House of Representatives have elected Ohio's Rep. Jim Jordan to serve as their next leader. NBC News' Sahil Kapur has details on the Jordan's past work and what his leadership may look like in charge of the minority party.

headlines.title: Senior U.S. Army soldier arrested in U.K. on suspicion of assisting Russian intelligence
Russia's last major independent newspaper shuts down citing Kremlin assault on free press
headlines.description: Novaya Gazeta, renowned for uncovering human rights abuses and corruption through fierce reporting, closes its doors after more than three decades. The news outlet says it's shutting down due to government pressure from the Kremlin. NBC News' Matt Bodner reports.

headlines.title: Several U.S. aircraft removed from U.K. airbase over Iran threats
headlines.description: Several U.S. military aircraft were relocated from a U.K. airbase amid a security threat linked to Iran. NBC News’ Keir Simmons reports on the latest developments and President Donald Trump’s strategy of a naval blockade.

headlines.title: Nvidia Loses $200B in Value Amid Alleged Chinese Spy Scandal
headlines.description: Nvidia, the world’s most valuable chipmaker, is facing major stock market losses and new scrutiny in Washington where the concern for national security and the demand for answers is growing. NBC’s Brian Cheung reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: We read Sofia Franklyn’s memoir about her falling out with Alex Cooper so you don’t have to
headlines.description: The “Daddy Gang” is finally getting to hear from the co- “founding father” of “Call Her Daddy.”

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: Missing baby found alive buried in dog crate in South Carolina
headlines.description: An 11-month-old baby boy who officials said was taken by his father on Monday was found buried alive in a dog crate Tuesday, a discovery a South Carolina sheriff called joyful.

headlines.title: Bernie Sanders says he won’t support Chuck Schumer for Senate majority leader
headlines.description: Sens. Sanders and Elissa Slotkin called for new leadership, but neither proposed an alternative. Sen. Chris Van Hollen of Maryland is considering challenging Schumer.
